result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection on a multi-lane road in a residential area, featuring sidewalks, curb ramps, and a marked bike lane. Pedestrian safety is hindered by faded crosswalk markings and a lack of visible pedestrian signals or refuge islands for the wide crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn and difficult to see, which may lead to drivers failing to yield.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a median or refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to reduce the unprotected crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on the remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals adjacent to a large institutional building. However, the wide turning radii and visible pavement degradation suggest a need for traffic calming and maintenance to better protect pedestrians.

hazards.name: Worn Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and surface wear in the intersection asphalt which can create tripping hazards or uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry is relatively open, which may encourage vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning across pedestrian paths.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner adjacent to the school building

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and physically slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to provide a smooth, predictable surface for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Refresh and upgrade the existing zebra markings to high-visibility continental patterns to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps with tactile warnings, located in a residential area. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and there is a lack of dedicated pedestrian signals, increasing risk at this crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, safety is compromised by significantly faded crosswalk markings and a large tree at the corner that likely obstructs sightlines between pedestrians and turning motorists.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are heavily worn and difficult to see, reducing driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree and utility pole at the corner may block the view of pedestrians waiting to cross from drivers approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Right-hand corner of the main intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental (zebra) markings to increase conspicuity.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight past the tree obstruction.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
